name: typesafe-tools
description: Optional bounded Jev evaluations with offline readiness and configurable spending controls.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect readiness and evaluate public evidence with Jev.
interface.longDescription: Bounded typed Jev evaluations for public or synthetic research evidence. Capped mode requires verified billing; an explicitly configured uncapped mode removes the wrapper spending limit. Existing tools retain ownership of evidence retrieval and external actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check TypeSafe readiness and explain whether public-evidence evaluation is available.
